deals.headline: David Blitzer's Bolt Football Holdings buys 45% of Hofmann Investoren GmbH, FC Augsburg's 99.4% owner
deals.seller: Two previous shareholders of Hofmann Investoren GmbH (with partial transfers by Project Green GmbH and Thilo Sautter)
deals.summary: Blitzer's Bolt Football Holdings acquired 45% of Hofmann Investoren GmbH, the holding that owns 99.4% of FC Augsburg's KGaA, replacing two departing shareholders; the stake's nominal value was EUR 5.5m (purchase price not disclosed). Hofmann said Blitzer invested from private wealth and that Hofmann remains sole managing director of the holding. The 45% is of the holding, not of the club directly.

notes: Revenue is the 2024/25 'Gesamterträge' (total income, including record transfer income from Demirović, Engels and Uduokhai) of the KGaA as reported by Augsburg Journal from the Nov 2025 members' meeting; the club's own release only says 'knapp 150 Millionen Euro'. The same report gives profit after tax of EUR 18.142m (not pretax, so pretax_result left null), equity of EUR 60.261m, and says the KGaA carries no debt and the stadium is fully paid off (no net-debt figure stated). The ownership article (Augsburg Journal, 4 June 2024) is no longer live and is cited via its Wayback Machine copy. Bolt's 45%, Hofmann's ~30%, Project Green's ~20% and Sautter's ~4% are shares of Hofmann Investoren GmbH, not of the club, so stake_pct is left null on those rows. Bloomberg (3 June 2024) reported Blitzer hired Lazard to sound out a sale that could value the club at more than EUR 150m; no completed sale found as of Oct 2026 (Bloomberg page not readable, so not used as a source). No Forbes/Deloitte valuation, no attendance or social-follower figures with a citable page were found. Capacity 30,660 is confirmed by the club's stadium page (bundesliga.com gives the same figure); the earlier record's Wikipedia source was replaced. FCA finished 9th in the 2025/26 Bundesliga and plays there in 2026/27.

ownership_summary: The professional side, FC Augsburg 1907 GmbH & Co. KGaA, is 99.4% held by Hofmann Investoren GmbH (since 2014), an investor holding in which David Blitzer's Bolt Football Holdings has held 45% since February 2021 alongside Klaus Hofmann (about 30%), Project Green GmbH (about 20%) and Thilo Sautter (about 4%). Under 50+1 the members' club, Fußball-Club Augsburg 1907 e. V., appoints the KGaA's management. In June 2024 Bloomberg reported Blitzer had hired Lazard to sound out a sale; no completed sale was found.
